name: loft_env_params_dispersion
built_for: Trainer: env loft params + stock lateral scatter; written 2026-10-17 America/New_York
honesty: No Instagram-derived or Mason-clip data, no video. Mason's 120+ mph is self-reported and unverified.
Ball rows are the repo analytic model (env/ball_flight_analytic.py, read-only import): MODEL, NOT a source. Dynamic loft = static loft_deg + unknown shaft/wrist offset (no published conversion).
No MuJoCo contact sweep was run: how loft_deg and AoA map to env launch needs a policy rollout (Trainer).

env_params.where: HumanoidGolfEnv.__init__ (env/humanoid_golf_env.py ~L117): head box geom_quat about y; None keeps the XML euler (3 deg in v2/v3/v4_power xml)
env_params.effect: static face tilt; launch ~ +0.85 deg per deg of dynamic loft at fixed AoA (model slope B->A rows)
env_params.suggested: reduce by ~5-6 deg from the loft that gave 12.6 deg launch to hit ~8 deg launch (model); verify by rollout

env_params.where: set by scripted swing (shoulder pitch q_fin/timing, wrist release) and ball_x / ball_x_noise
env_params.effect: launch ~ AoA + 0.85-0.9*SL; spin falls with AoA at fixed dyn loft
env_params.suggested: AoA +2..+4 for 130 mph; arc geometry: ball_x shift dx moves AoA by ~dx/R rad, R = pivot-to-head ~1.6-1.8 m ASSUMED (0.05 m ~ 1.7 deg; ball_x_noise 0.03 m ~ +-1 deg)

env_params.where: env/humanoid_golf_env.py L376/L400: ball z = 0.021 + tee_height + ball_dz
env_params.effect: where on the face/arc the strike lands (impact_model dz0 -0.019 centres the face-strike height term); raising the ball relative to the arc lowers spin, raises launch for a given face
env_params.suggested: keep strike within +-0.02 m of dz0; do not use ball_dz as a loft knob

env_params.effect: launch direction comes from MuJoCo contact (NOT overwritten); gain scales ball speed; spin rpm = spin_k*|v_ball|*sin(radians(max(launch_elev+2,0))), clipped 0-6000; sidespin = k_side*dy
env_params.suggested: spin_k 130 (v4yaw) gives rows in env_impact_model_spin_k130_rpm; at 8-9 deg launch spin_k=130 gives ~1500-2000 rpm at 100-130 mph (rows); to hold ~2200-2500 use spin_k ~150-165 (arithmetic scaling, e.g. 130*2300/1991); lower launch lowers env spin automatically, so re-check the 1800-3000 gate band

env_params.effect: reward centres launch at elev_target_deg=12.5 default (and fallback rpm 1500+70*elev); a policy is pulled to 12.5-12.6 by this term
env_params.suggested: set elev_target_deg ~8-9 (model carry optimum at 130 mph is ~10-11 deg, see table) to move launch toward 7.8; THIS is the most likely reason power tier sits at 12.6

env_params.effect: PD lag shifts effective wrist w at contact; more cocked (w>0) = hands ahead = less loft; re-measure dynamic loft after the lead fix
env_params.suggested: aim w in the w_contact band 0.173-0.564*elbow_rad +-0.1 (earlier repo analysis, not re-derived); do not force forward lean (driver needs +AoA)

env_params.where: no explicit param; head box yaw from club path/wrist/forearm rotation
env_params.effect: start line ~76% face / 24% path; lateral via k_side*dy only
env_params.suggested: log face angle and path at contact to use the dispersion section

env_params.where: analytic ball model / data.targets_130mph_350yd.impact_k; env/ball_flight_analytic.impact default mu=0.22, e=0.83 (repo docs use e=0.845, K 4.0 or 5.6)
env_params.effect: K 5.6 lowers spin ~30% (2121->1515 rpm at 130 mph, AoA+3 DL10.5) and adds 3-6 yd carry; e caps smash (<=1.50)
env_params.suggested: K=5.6 for TrackMan-like spin (repo impact doc); e=0.845

carry_vs_launch_note: Carry change vs baseline A (AoA +5, DL 14.5, launch 12.9), model K=4.0 / K=5.6. 130 mph: launch 10-11 (B,C) +6.7/+7.5 | +1.5/-2.6; launch 9.2 (D) +2.8 | -4.4; launch 8.2 (F, G) +0.1/-0.1 | -8.3/-15.5; launch 7.5 (E) -5.7 | -11.4. 120 mph: B +2.6, C -0.3, D -3.3, F -7.2, E -11.5, G -11.9 (K=4.0); K=5.6 is 5-14 yd worse. 100 mph: every lower-launch row loses 6-32 yd (K=4.0). So 7.8-8.2 deg launch is carry-neutral only at ~130 mph with K=4.0 and AoA +2..+4 / DL 9-9.5; at K=5.6 or lower speed it costs 8-40 yd. The model carry optimum is ~10-11 deg at 130 mph. Tutelman: optimal launch falls with ball speed (190 mph ball -> ~7 deg at AoA 0).

sources_numbers.metric: sigma of direction (angle between start-end line and start-target line) on long tee shots: Pro 4.0 deg (d0.75 297 yd), Am1 (scoring avg 70-83) 5.4, Am2 6.4, Am3 8.1; 4 deg = 14 yd @200, 21 yd @300; fit sigma = -0.0315*d0.75 + 13.223
sources_numbers.caveat: all long tee shots (not only driver), ShotLink-era data, includes curve+roll, c. 2008

sources_numbers.metric: PGA Tour driver 275 yd carry: F2P -2 deg ~ 19 yd left curve, +5 deg ~ 44 yd right; 1 deg F2P ~ 12 yd at 300 yd; elite player should keep F2P within ~1 deg (1.5 deg forces aiming off the fairway)
sources_numbers.caveat: vendor blog; curvature in yards at carry

sources_numbers.metric: Driver horizontal launch toward face angle 76% +-8% (95% CI, n=89 filtered shots, F2P >=1.5 deg); 7-iron 69%+-3; wedge 61%+-7; vertical launch toward dynamic loft: driver 83%+-8%; robot 63%+-4 horizontal (7-iron); 731 driver shots/157 golfers (via Pebble summary: PING, Vicon + Foresight)
sources_numbers.caveat: peer-reviewed proceedings; I read excerpts not the full PDF

sources_numbers.metric: 1 deg of target-line/calibration error ~ 4 yd side dispersion over 250 yd carry; driver club path TrackMan -3.75 vs Mevo+ -2.25 deg (one golfer); driver path/plane absolute agreement poor
sources_numbers.verification: abstract fetched; the 4 yd and -3.75/-2.25 figures via Pebble summary

sources_numbers.metric: 3, 5 and 7 handicappers, GCQuad, stock drives: ~70 yd side-to-side (about +-35 yd) after discarding outliers
one ~scratch golfer, 20 driver shots on a mat: 68.6 yd left-right; author cites Scott Fawcett (DECADE) 65-70 yd typical for scratch or better
tour 18-22 yd, scratch 25-30 yd 'lateral spread' (95% ellipse claimed)
sources_numbers.caveat: LOW CONFIDENCE: no data source, conflicts with the 65-70 yd width above; do not use

sources_numbers.metric: no lateral yards; men 0-4.9 hcp: 249.9-250 yd avg, 49.3% fairways hit, 12.0% wayward (4.4% penalty + 7.6% recovery)

sources_numbers.metric: TrackMan 15 tour pros vs 15 semi-pros: tour pros had lower CV in club path, dynamic loft, launch angle (no degree values)

model_assumptions.note: Real face and path are positively correlated, which shrinks F2P variance; calibrating to Broadie's total direction sigma with independent equal sigmas therefore UNDERSTATES real face/path sigmas. No published face-angle or path sigma for 100-120 mph players was found.

bc_prior_options.content: 10 trials (64_01-64_10), one unnamed subject, right-handed, no ball, no club-head, 120 Hz -> dt 0.01, 11 joint columns (deg). Downswing 0.43-0.60 s (tour ~0.25), peak hand speed 3.5-4.6 m/s, 3 trials flagged low_hand_speed.
bc_prior_options.use: Sequencing/shape prior only (already done in env/style_prior.py: thorax-yaw and wrist-hinge curve shapes, time-normalised). Not a speed or impact target.
bc_prior_options.feasibility: Retarget to the env's 11-column arm/torso model is DONE (kinematic, 3-D FK-derived). 10 demos is too few for a BC policy that generalises; usable as (a) DeepMimic-style tracking reference + RSI, (b) a residual-policy base clip (env/residual_golf_env.py), (c) pre-train/regularise sequencing only. Playing it at 130 mph needs ~2x time compression of the downswing: check torque/velocity limits first (docs/research_humanoid_actuators.md). Mirror for a left-hander (docs/HANDEDNESS.md; CMU is right-handed).
